meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询40多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个生物数据库间进行联合查询和ID映射
copy.tagline_en: Query 40+ bioinformatics databases with a unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple biological databases and map IDs across them

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你从 40 多个生物信息学数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL）中查询和整合数据，比如搜索蛋白质序列、分析代谢通路、查找化合物信息，还能在不同数据库之间转换标识符。
howto.when: 当你需要同时查询多个生物数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome），或者进行跨数据库分析、标识符映射时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下人类 ZAP70 蛋白的序列和功能注释。
找出 KEGG 中与 B 细胞相关的通路。
say.note: 会调用 KEGG 搜索通路名称，返回匹配的通路 ID。

say.text: 把 KEGG 化合物 C11222 映射到 ChEMBL 的 ID。
say.note: 会使用 UniChem 进行跨数据库标识符转换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and integrate data from 40+ bioinformatics services (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL), such as retrieving protein sequences, analyzing metabolic pathways, searching compounds, and mapping identifiers across databases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to query multiple biological databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow, or perform cross-database analysis and identifier mapping.

say_en.text: Retrieve the sequence and functional annotations of human ZAP70 protein.
say_en.note: Fetches FASTA sequence and annotations from UniProt.

say_en.text: Find KEGG pathways related to B cells.
say_en.note: Searches KEGG for pathway names and returns matching IDs.

say_en.text: Map KEGG compound C11222 to its ChEMBL ID.
say_en.note: Uses UniChem for cross-database identifier conversion.
